prompt: make a voxel chair with oak and ornate jewels in the top
make a voxel lantern with a candle glowing inside
make a voxel treasure chest with the lid open and gold coins inside
make a voxel sword with a gold hilt and a gem in the pommel
make a voxel oak tree
make a voxel stone well with a wooden roof and a bucket on a rope
make a voxel robot whose head and arms can turn
make a voxel mushroom cottage with a round door and windows
make a voxel glass potion bottle with a cork and red potion inside
make a voxel wooden cart with four wheels
make a voxel acoustic guitar with a round sound hole and six strings
stress: Six strings across a 5 cm neck need voxels of about 5 mm. The guitar then runs about 200 voxels long against the skill's 16 to 64. The body takes 2D booleans and stays hollow under a one-voxel top

prompt: make a voxel iron candelabra with a twisted square stem and five lit candles on curling arms
stress: A twist reads only once the stem's section spans several cells. Bends or torus arcs make the arms, and five arms repeat off the orthographic axes

prompt: make a voxel knight character for my game, 32 voxels tall, in the pico-8 palette
stress: `--resolution world-y 32` meets the height with an unround voxel size that breaks `const v`. The 16-color pico-8 palette rules out `shades` and tests where the armor reads flat

prompt: make a voxel pocket watch on a chain with the gears showing
stress: Millimeter voxels sit below every example in the skill, and gear teeth take one cell each. Interlocked links share no cells, so a correct chain reports a piece per link. Gold renders olive under the review lighting

prompt: model a voxel dragon curled up asleep on a pile of gold with its wings folded
stress: The dragon's anatomy has no sweep or skeleton to build on and comes from `smoothUnion`, `roundCone`, and `bend`. The renders judge it by silhouette

prompt: make a voxel suspension bridge over a river with two stone towers and hanging cables
stress: The cables hang in curves that no operation draws and take computed points. Hangers of different lengths need a loop, and sloped one-voxel cables can split into pieces. The bridge spans about 10:1 in square review frames

prompt: model a voxel chess set with every piece in its starting position
stress: A part keeps the materials of its steps, so each piece needs a part per color. Five lathe profiles and a sculpted knight make 32 placements. White pieces stand on light squares

prompt: make a cyberpunk voxel ramen stand with a neon sign that says ramen
stress: Lettering has no operation and comes from strokes a whole cell wide. The sign has to read the right way round in the front view, and several emissive colors have to stay distinct without bloom

prompt: make a voxel dungeon kit for my game: floor, wall, corner, and doorway tiles on a 2 m grid with the floors tagged walkable, then a small room built from the kit
stress: The walkable tag shows in neither the report nor the renders, and the log checks the palette with `vxl vox-doc show`. Building the room from the kit pushes the session toward a library or an import. Separate tiles read as extra pieces on a correct kit
check: Check each run's final voxj palette for the walkable tag with `vxl vox-doc show <file>.voxj`.

prompt: build a voxel construction crane whose cab turns and boom tilts, with a hook hanging on a cable
stress: Parts nest three or four deep, and their offsets and pivots add up. The renders cannot show a joint turn, and the log checks each pivot in the voxj nodes against its hinge
check: Check each joint pivot in the final voxj nodes against its hinge with `vxl vox-doc show` or jq.

prompt: make a voxel fish tank with fish, seaweed, gravel, bubbles, and a little castle inside
stress: Opaque fish and the castle inside solid water read `0 exposed` on a correct model and render dark behind the water. Bubbles float as pieces. The glass takes `#RRGGBBAA`

prompt: build a voxel wizard tower with stairs spiraling up the outside and a crooked pointed roof
stress: A helix has no operation. A twist on a stack of treads makes one but breaks the treads into fragments. A bend shapes the crooked roof

prompt: make a voxel log cabin buried in snow with icicles on the roof and smoke from the chimney
stress: `coat` lays the snow. The smoke floats on purpose against the second-piece check. The library's snow and ice render nearly alike, and icicles can vanish against the snow

prompt: model a voxel mountain valley with a river and a pine forest, under 300k voxels
stress: Solid terrain over about 200 m passes 300k voxels at 1 m and forces surface fill, a coarser grid, or a shell. Displaced terrain leaves dozens of one-voxel crumbs in the piece lines. The trees and the river have to meet a surface the model cannot query

prompt: build a voxel village of thatched cottages and a stone church around a little market square
stress: A reused cottage part cannot turn to face the square. Copies repeat their patterns exactly unless each copy takes its own seed. The church stands as the one building that is no copy

prompt: build a small voxel city with streets, tall buildings, a park, and street lights as one object for my game
stress: One voxel size has to serve a 100 m scene with sub-meter windows. The front and right views hide the streets, and the report runs hundreds of lines. "One object" pushes `--flatten objects`

prompt: build a voxel two-story house with the front wall cut away to show the furnished rooms
stress: The prompt asks for the cutaway, which makes the dollhouse the control for 28 to 30. One voxel size has to stretch from the house down to chair legs

prompt: make a cozy voxel living room with a fireplace, an armchair, a bookshelf full of books, and a rug
stress: Every review view looks from outside, and the session has to find a way to show the room. The books need variety across copies

prompt: make a voxel spaceship bridge with a captain's chair, a glowing radar screen, and a big window out to the stars
stress: The hull hides the bridge from every outside view. The stars float as hundreds of pieces and inflate the bounds. The radar screen takes sectors and arcs that have to read on a glowing panel

prompt: make a voxel pirate ship interior below deck with cannons, hammocks, barrels, and a hanging lantern
stress: A curved hull built as a shell of a union can leave inner walls. The hammocks sag as one-cell sheets, and the cannons sit in carved ports. The lantern lights nothing under the review lighting
